gloss: person concerned; eligible person; applicable person

definitions.gloss: person concerned; eligible person; applicable person
definitions.explanation: a person who meets certain conditions, criteria, or qualifications and is therefore subject to a rule, benefit, or requirement

examples.japanese: {該当者|がいとうしゃ}は{申|もう}し{出|で}てください。
examples.english: Those who are eligible, please come forward.

examples.japanese: {該当者|がいとうしゃ}には{後日|ごじつ}{通知|つうち}が{届|とど}きます。
examples.english: Those who qualify will receive notification at a later date.

examples.japanese: {条件|じょうけん}に{該当|がいとう}する{該当者|がいとうしゃ}が{多数|たすう}いたため、{抽選|ちゅうせん}で{決|き}めることになった。
examples.english: Since there were many eligible persons who met the conditions, it was decided by lottery.

notes:
Combines {該当|がいとう} (applicable, corresponding) and {者|しゃ} (person). A formal, administrative term frequently seen on forms, in official announcements, and in workplace communications. Often used when describing who is eligible for benefits, subject to regulations, or included in a particular category.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {該当者|がいとうしゃ}なし: no applicable person; nobody qualifies
- {該当者|がいとうしゃ}がいる: there is someone who qualifies
- {該当者|がいとうしゃ}を{選|えら}ぶ: to select the eligible persons
- {該当者|がいとうしゃ}{全員|ぜんいん}: all persons concerned

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {対象者|たいしょうしゃ}: target person; subject — someone targeted by a program or action
- {関係者|かんけいしゃ}: person involved; stakeholder — someone connected to a matter, broader than {該当者|がいとうしゃ}
- {有資格者|ゆうしかくしゃ}: qualified person — someone holding a specific certification or license
